integrity: The complete deterministic simplicial verification is reproducible using the included standard-library Python 3 program; all accompanying artifact byte lengths and SHA-256 digests are recorded.
scientific_limitations: Only the third non-matching complex of the sixteen-vertex graph GP(8,3) is classified; no generalized family, higher matching threshold or equivariant representation is claimed. Unindexed bibliographic overlap remains possible.
title: Forty-five three-spheres in the third non-matching complex of the Möbius–Kantor graph
